title: README states port 5000 but app serves on 5001
evidence: README.md:34 says http://localhost:5000; app.py:187 runs app.run(..., port=5001)
suggestion: Update the README to 5001 (or change app.py to 5000) so the documented URL is correct.

title: Author filter uses LIKE substring match rather than exact match
evidence: app.py:91 SELECT ... WHERE author LIKE '%<author>%' — matches partial/substring authors
suggestion: Acceptable enhancement; note it is broader than an exact ?author= match if strict equality was intended.
